messages:
Emma L: Quick q — before we enable automatic rollouts with auto-degrade, can we agree on a safety matrix that defines triggers, degrade modes, and the audit records we keep? Need to think about console UX + telemetry. @Kai can you weigh in?

Kai M: Yup. I sketched something earlier. Thinking modes: 'soft-degrade' (reduce concurrency), 'probabilistic-fallback' (route X% to stable variant), 'latency-only' (route to faster model), 'full-rollback' (stop rollout).

Owen R: +1 for probabilistic. It gives us a gradual mitigation instead of 0/100. Also important: percentage ramping rules and cool-down windows.

Sarah P: Telemetry needs to be explicit: per-route SLIs (errors, p50/p95 latency), per-decision audit entry (decision, trigger, metric snapshot, traffic pct, actor) and a link to trace. We should NOT log raw prompt text by default.

Emma L: Can someone show a tiny example of the audit record shape we expect? Console should surface reason, metrics at the time, impacted pct of traffic, and a trace link.

Ana V: Example audit record I use for privacy review:
```json
{
  "decision": "soft-degrade",
  "trigger": "latency_p95>800ms for 5m",
  "metric_snapshot": {"p95": 920, "error_rate": 0.018},
  "traffic_pct": 20,
  "actor": "automatic-rollout",
  "trace_id": "abc123",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T13:16:30Z"
}
```

Kai M: Agree with Sarah/Ana — store hashed request identifiers + model version + prompt metadata, avoid raw request text. Also include config snapshot (model id, quantization profile, batching settings).

deploy-bot: deploy: canary/rollout-service v2.1 started by @Owen R — ID dpl-9087 :rocket:

Owen R: UX idea: when an automatic decision triggers, show a toast in the console and a link to a 'safety reasons' modal that lists the metric snapshot, the rule matched, and an option to 'pause auto-actions' for N minutes. Should we also expose an immediate 'undo' for a short window?

Sarah P: Undo for auto-actions is risky for stateful systems. Better to expose a manual override button that requires confirmation and logs the actor. Maybe limit to enterprise tiers.

Emma L: Action items: Kai - formalise the safety matrix; Sarah - telemetry schema + retention; Ana - minimal audit example for privacy review; Owen - mockup modal/CTA in console. I'll open a follow-up ticket and schedule a 30m sync.

Emma L: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-1428 — please add estimates and link designs.

Kai M: :thumbsup: One quick question on defaults: propose triggers = p95 > 750ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows OR error_rate > 2% (0.02). Thoughts?

Sarah P: Fine as a starting point but we'll normalise per-model baselines in the telemetry service. Also need blackout windows for noisy experiments.

Ana V: Privacy note: if a customer opts out of request retention, audit entries must still contain decision + metrics + hashed request id only. Document that in compliance doc.

Owen R: I'll mock the modal with 3 stable states: info (no action), auto-actioned (shows reason + rollback button disabled by default), manual-intervention (show who flipped it). Keep copy terse.

Emma L: Thanks all. We'll review in the sync in 30m. @Kai can you paste the initial matrix into this thread?

Kai M: Pasting quick table (rows = triggers, cols = modes):
- latency_p95 high -> soft-degrade -> route % (10-30%) -> notify (console + email)
- error_rate high -> probabilistic-fallback -> route 10-50% -> page if >50%
- sustained spike -> full-rollback -> 100% -> page + incident runbook
I'll convert to a doc and attach designs.
